speaker: barclay
caption: My kids don't want the house, Drew, they want the three-percent mortgage.
action: Barclay raises his old fashioned an inch off the marble, the cherry rolling against the cube. Drew's martini rests on its coaster, his feathered hands folded in front of it, his head turned to Barclay.
tv: FEW HOMES FOR SALE AS OWNERS STAY PUT
tvPicture: a moving truck parked at a curb with its ramp up and its rear doors shut, no lettering on the truck
turn: theft — the loan filed as the family heirloom

speaker: drew
caption: Inflation is almost back to normal, and nobody has told my dry cleaner.
action: Drew lifts his martini by the stem and the coaster comes up with it, stuck to the foot of the glass. Barclay holds his old fashioned in both hands and watches the coaster.
tvPicture: a long row of nested shopping carts in an empty parking lot
board: PRICES ON THIS BOARD: 12 · PRICES THAT CAME DOWN: 0
turn: collision — inflation down, prices stuck (the coaster acts it out)

speaker: barclay
caption: I've never paid full price for anything. I just pay the renewal.
action: Barclay holds his old fashioned in both hands, shoulders settled and content. Drew's hand lies flat on the marble beside his untouched martini, his head turned to Barclay.
tv: PROMOTIONAL RATES END FOR MILLIONS OF CUSTOMERS
tvPicture: a curbside mailbox stuffed so full of plain envelopes that its door hangs open
board: OLD FASHIONED, FIRST YEAR $9 · YEAR FOUR $16
turn: contradiction — never full price, always the renewal

speaker: drew
caption: It's good to see my grocery bill taking an interest in foreign policy.
action: Drew lifts his martini an inch in a small toast toward the television. Barclay turns the nut bowl a quarter turn and studies it.
tvPicture: a supermarket aisle of shelves stocked with plain unlabelled cans and boxes, nobody in the aisle
turn: misfile — a tariff on his groceries filed as civic engagement

speaker: abby
caption: No resort fee on your tab. I'd have to buy better nuts.
action: Abby tops up the nut bowl from a large glass jar, smiling. Barclay already has a hand in the bowl; Drew has his martini lifted an inch off its coaster.
tv: HOTEL RESORT FEES FACE NEW RULES
tvPicture: an empty hotel swimming pool ringed with lounge chairs, nobody in them
turn: contradiction — she rules out the fee and demotes her own amenity

speaker: drew
caption: Artificial intelligence is just electricity with a business plan.
action: Abby lowers one large ice cube into Barclay's rocks glass with a pair of tongs, smiling, while Barclay steadies the glass with one hand. Drew holds his martini by the stem and watches the television.
tv: DATA CENTERS PUSH POWER DEMAND HIGHER
tvPicture: a row of high-voltage transmission towers marching toward one long windowless building
turn: definition — the boom demoted to its utility bill

speaker: barclay
caption: Rates came down at the Fed, Drew, and stayed right where they were on my credit card.
action: Barclay slides a credit card back into his wallet, held up in front of his chest. Drew rests one feathered hand flat on the marble beside the nut bowl, his martini untouched, his head turned to Barclay.
tv: CREDIT CARD RATES NEAR RECORD HIGH
tvPicture: the marble front of the Federal Reserve building with its tall bronze doors shut, the facade blank of any carved lettering
turn: status report — down at the Fed, unchanged at the register

speaker: drew
caption: We all complain about the insurance premium and then buy the place on the water.
action: Drew lays his free hand flat on his own sweater vest, martini in the other hand, guilty as charged. Barclay rubs the back of his own neck with one hand.
tvPicture: a beach house on tall stilts with surf breaking under it
turn: contradiction — the complaint and the cause are the same people, the speaker first

speaker: abby
caption: The old fashioned is fourteen here and thirty-one delivered.
action: Abby sets a fresh old fashioned down in front of Barclay and keeps her hand on the glass, smiling. Barclay looks at the glass; Drew lifts his martini by the stem.
tvPicture: an insulated delivery bag standing open on a doorstep, empty
turn: theft — the delivery fee priced from the bar's side of the door

speaker: barclay
caption: I don't mind tipping twenty percent on a coffee. I'd just like the coffee first.
action: Abby slides Barclay's old fashioned the last inch toward him, smiling, her hand still on the glass. Barclay has both hands folded on the marble, waiting; Drew lifts his martini by the stem.
tvPicture: an empty paper coffee cup on a counter beside a tablet on a stand, its screen dark and turned toward an empty stool, nobody behind the counter
turn: concession — the tip granted, the coffee requested
